opportunities.name: Mixed Death Lotus channel
opportunities.objective: Explore Lotus's explicit attack-speed-linked physical term.
opportunities.mechanic: Death Lotus knives have 0.19 AP magic damage and an AD statFormula expression multiplied by an attack-speed-stat term. Gunblade and Nashor supply mixed/AP offense while Rageblade supplies attack speed; Blade and Terminus serve real attacks woven before the channel. Any R item on-hit delivery is a separate unverified component, so this route first tests documented knife scaling.
opportunities.requiredState: Need safe preparation attacks, enemy interrupt tools spent and an uninterrupted 2.5-second channel.
opportunities.failure: Interrupts erase most value; mixed penetration needs attacks before R and magic Q loses raw AP.
opportunities.test: Compare Lotus physical/magic totals at two attack-speed values, with all item procs logged separately.
opportunities.rejectedAssumption: Fifteen knives are not fifteen full-strength ordinary on-hit attacks for every item.

opportunities.name: Dagger corridor burn skirmisher
opportunities.objective: Reward repeated dagger pickups while buying survival through a reset.
opportunities.mechanic: Voracity dagger pickup deals magic damage with AD and level-varying AP terms; pickups reduce Shunpo cooldown and takedowns reduce all abilities by 15 seconds. Rylai may keep enemies near dropped daggers, while Liandry/Riftmaker reward actual repeated magic contact. Visage supports received omnivamp healing once Riftmaker ramps, rather than inventing an innate dagger heal.
opportunities.requiredState: Need accessible daggers, continued combat and a qualifying takedown for the next full cycle.
opportunities.failure: Targets move away from daggers; waiting for sustained effects may sacrifice the first reset.
opportunities.test: Count pickups, E cooldown reductions and post-ramp healing across a moving-target eight-second skirmish.
opportunities.rejectedAssumption: A pickup cooldown reduction does not mean unconditional instant E resets at every level.

ruledOut.reason: The passive dagger slash and Shunpo are magic despite their AD terms.

unknowns: Lotus on-hit modifiers, attack-speed statFormula meaning and Rageblade channel applicability need live proof.

builds.name: Mixed Death Lotus channel
builds.summary: Explore Lotus's explicit attack-speed-linked physical term.
builds.goal: Explore Lotus's explicit attack-speed-linked physical term.
builds.hypothesis: Death Lotus knives have 0.19 AP magic damage and an AD statFormula expression multiplied by an attack-speed-stat term. Gunblade and Nashor supply mixed/AP offense while Rageblade supplies attack speed; Blade and Terminus serve real attacks woven before the channel. Any R item on-hit delivery is a separate unverified component, so this route first tests documented knife scaling.
testPlan: Required state: Need safe preparation attacks, enemy interrupt tools spent and an uninterrupted 2.5-second channel.
Compare Lotus physical/magic totals at two attack-speed values, with all item procs logged separately.

Run three trials at matched level, ranks, gold and target defenses. Repeat against a moving opponent with a fixed incoming damage pattern. Record damage packets, missed actions, resource cost and survival separately.
Keep souls, health/mana, form, item/rune stacks, transformations and game time finite and explicitly recorded. No free full ramp or infinite scaling.
failureConditions: Interrupts erase most value; mixed penetration needs attacks before R and magic Q loses raw AP.
The narrow damage gain does not repay lost access, survival, wave control or allied utility.
tradeoffs: Rejected assumption: Fifteen knives are not fifteen full-strength ordinary on-hit attacks for every item.
Confidence: plausible. Source-compatible reasoning is not in-game validation or proof of novelty/optimality.
buyOrder: Candidate six slots: Blade of The Ruined King, Nashor's Tooth, Guinsoo's Rageblade, Terminus, Hextech Gunblade, Berserker's Greaves. Compare two-item checkpoints before the final six-slot test; this list is not a lane shopping order.
Keep role-appropriate starters, boots and support quest/vision obligations. If the full candidate assumes farmed income, compare it separately from support income.
coverageNotes: Only Cassiopeia Q/E and Sett W have numerical adapters. Even there, these other objectives and item/rune interactions may fall outside the model.
Proc inheritance, crit, pet hits and conditional helpers remain uncertain until observed. No completed mathematical maximum is claimed.

kitEvidence.formula:
Katarina becomes a flurry of blades, rapidly attacking the three nearest enemy champions with a flurry of knives. Each knife deals [25 / 37.5 / 50 + (0.19) × AP] magic damage and [(((0.16) × ((1 + (3.125) × Stat(4)[statFormula=2])))) × AD[statFormula=2]] physical damage, and applies [40]% Grievous Wounds for [3] seconds.

Total over [2.5] seconds to each enemy: [(25 / 37.5 / 50 + (0.19) × AP) × ((6) × (2.5))] magic damage and [((((0.16) × ((1 + (3.125) × Stat(4)[statFormula=2])))) × AD[statFormula=2]) × ((6) × (2.5))] physical damage.
Katarina throws a Dagger, dealing [80 / 115 / 150 / 185 / 220 + (0.4) × AP] magic damage to the target and [2] nearby enemies. The Dagger then ricochets onto the ground behind the primary target.

Katarina blinks in the wink of an eye to the target ally, enemy, or Dagger. If it is an enemy, Katarina strikes for [20 / 30 / 40 / 50 / 60 + (0.25) × AP + (0.4) × AD] magic damage - otherwise she strikes the nearest enemy in range.

Picking up a Dagger will reduce this Ability's Cooldown by [(characterLevelBreakpoints(start=0.78, perLevel=0, changes=[{"mLevel": 6, "mAdditionalBonusAtThisLevel": 0.05999999865889549, "__type": "Breakpoint"}, {"mLevel": 11, "mAdditionalBonusAtThisLevel": 0.05999999865889549, "__type": "Breakpoint"}, {"mLevel": 16, "mAdditionalBonusAtThisLevel": 0.05999999865889549, "__type": "Breakpoint"}, {"mLevel": 21, "mAdditionalBonusAtThisLevel": 0.03999999910593033, "__type": "Breakpoint"}])) × ((runtimeCooldownMultiplier) × (12 / 11 / 10 / 9 / 8))] seconds ([characterLevelBreakpoints(start=0.78, perLevel=0, changes=[{"mLevel": 6, "mAdditionalBonusAtThisLevel": 0.05999999865889549, "__type": "Breakpoint"}, {"mLevel": 11, "mAdditionalBonusAtThisLevel": 0.05999999865889549, "__type": "Breakpoint"}, {"mLevel": 16, "mAdditionalBonusAtThisLevel": 0.05999999865889549, "__type": "Breakpoint"}, {"mLevel": 21, "mAdditionalBonusAtThisLevel": 0.03999999910593033, "__type": "Breakpoint"}])]). Katarina can blink to any location near the target.
Katarina tosses a Dagger into the air and gains [50 / 60 / 70 / 80 / 90]% Move Speed decaying over [1.25] seconds.

Whenever an enemy champion dies that Katarina has damaged in the last [3] seconds, her Ability Cooldowns are reduced by [15] seconds.

If Katarina picks up a Dagger, she uses it to slash through all nearby enemies, dealing [characterLevelTable[0, 68.1846, 72.1385, 76.8615, 82.3538, 88.6154, 95.6462, 103.446, 112.015, 121.354, 131.462, 142.338, 153.985, 166.4, 179.585, 193.538, 208.262, 223.754, 240.015, 257.046, 274.846, 293.415, 312.754, 332.862, 353.738, 375.385, 397.8, 420.985, 444.938, 469.662, 495.154] + (0.6) × AD[statFormula=2] + (characterLevelBreakpoints(start=0.7, perLevel=0, changes=[{"mLevel": 6, "mAdditionalBonusAtThisLevel": 0.10000000149011612, "__type": "Breakpoint"}, {"mLevel": 11, "mAdditionalBonusAtThisLevel": 0.10000000149011612, "__type": "Breakpoint"}, {"mLevel": 16, "mAdditionalBonusAtThisLevel": 0.10000000149011612, "__type": "Breakpoint"}])) × AP] magic damage.
